task: T-129 — is C-0063's flat 34-root placement flat over a RANGE?
conditions: T = 300 K, k_BT = 4.141947 pN nm; aqueous MgCl2 at 0.5 / 2 / 10 mM; 40.0 x 40.35 nm single-layer square-lattice Rothemund sheet, 15 duplexes at 2.69 nm, phase 24 carrying its OWN eight crossover columns; C-0055's 34 upward roots at C-0063's swept placement; C-0017's 33.3333 pN/nm mandate as a SUM; C-0022's SOLVED edge profiles keyed on (concentration, gap, bias); C-0001's foundation secant; free-tile stroke 4.90731 nm
decision: with EQUAL springs C-0063's placement dishes 0.0789 / 0.0853 / 0.0896 of the stroke over the three 10 nm devices' own traversed ranges — all inside T-5b's 0.10 — and 0.2000 over the 5 nm device's, which is outside it and is recovered by a distribution at 0.0565

bounds.name: the per-state least-squares floor, worst over the four device ranges
bounds.settles: no distribution whatever on C-0063's 34 stations can beat this at that state, so a floor above 0.10 would prove the placement is a single-state result; dishing is affine in the attachment forces and every distribution produces some force vector

bounds.name: the worst free-field cosine of the design state against another state
bounds.settles: C-0064's instrument: a negative cosine means the two loads dish the free tile in opposite senses and no one correction serves both — it costs one pass over two precomputed fields and needs no optimiser

bounds.name: the stroke C-0022's 2 nm state demands of a 10 nm device
bounds.settles: against C-0050's dead-load stroke at S3's own 100 pN — the largest of its six layer models at the 10 nm design point — which is what makes the exclusion of that state PHYSICAL rather than convenient

bounds.name: C-0050's dead-load stroke at a 10 nm layer, the largest anywhere it solved
bounds.settles: the ceiling the 8 nm demand above is read against, taken over all six layer models AND every grafting density of C-0027's 10 nm window (at S3's own sigma = 0.024 nm^-2 it is 6.0135 nm); C-0017's own theorem is that a coupling can only REDUCE the delivered stroke, so this is a supremum over every coupling that could ever be designed

bounds.name: C-0050's dead-load stroke at S3's own 5 nm layer, the largest of six models
bounds.settles: reported because it does NOT clear the 3 nm its own device needs to reach C-0022's 2 nm state: that state is held by its own solved 0.368 V bias and not by a 100 pN dead load, which is a fact about C-0022's state set and is recorded rather than smoothed

predicates.name: P1 — equal springs over a traversed range
predicates.statement: the worst peak dishing of 34 EQUAL springs on C-0063's placement over each device's own range, against T-5b's 0.10 of the free-tile stroke
predicates.verdict: 0.0789 / 0.0853 / 0.2000 / 0.0896 over the four devices — 3 of 4 inside T-5b's 0.10 with EQUAL springs, the exception being 2 mM, L0 = 5 nm, 0.368 V

predicates.name: P2 — does the range need a distribution?
predicates.statement: the 34-parameter multi-state minimax against the equal-spring reading over the same range, at C-0017's unchanged total
predicates.verdict: 0.0291 / 0.0366 / 0.0565 / 0.0382 over the four devices, ALL FOUR inside T-5b's 0.10; at the design device the distribution is worth 63.0 % over equal springs and asks a peak ratio of only 1.83, and the one range equal springs miss is recovered at a peak ratio of 2.32

predicates.verdict: the 2 nm state is NOT occupied by any 10 nm device and IS the compressed end of the 5 nm device, whose own range reads 0.2000 — the exclusion is physical, and it excludes nothing, because that device is evaluated too

predicates.name: P4 — is the single-state placement the right placement for a range?
predicates.statement: the centro-symmetric family re-enumerated exhaustively under the range objective
predicates.verdict: phase 8: best 0.0910 against C-0063's 0.0789, 0 of 163296 placements better; phase 8: best 0.0895 against C-0063's 0.2000, 30465 of 163296 placements better; phase 24: best 0.0789 against C-0063's 0.0789, 0 of 198288 placements better; phase 24: best 0.1169 against C-0063's 0.2000, 27355 of 198288 placements better

predicates.name: the portfolio duty, for contrast
predicates.statement: the same placement asked to be flat at all five of C-0022's headline states at once
predicates.verdict: 0.2000 with equal springs and 0.1124 with the best distribution found — OUTSIDE T-5b's 0.10

findings: C-0063's placement is flat with EQUAL springs over the traversed range of every 10 nm device C-0022 solved, and over no other: 0.0789 (2 mM, C-0018's placed device), 0.0853 (0.5 mM, C-0032's recommendation) and 0.0896 (10 mM), against 0.0706 at the single state C-0063 reported. So the single-state verdict TRAVELS for the device it was read on — but the margin against T-5b's 0.10 falls from 1.42x to 1.12x, and it is the compressed end of the stroke that spends it.

The exception is the FIVE nanometre device, and it is the one whose range contains C-0022's 2 nm state: equal springs dish 0.2000 there, 2.0x outside the convention, where the same equal springs on C-0058's 3 x 15 grid dish 0.0796 (re-derived here) and are inside it. On this station set the 5 nm device NEEDS a distribution — the 34-parameter minimax recovers it to 0.0565 at a peak ratio of 2.32 — so C-0063's equal-spring advantage is a property of the 10 nm devices, not of the placement.

And at the 5 nm layer's states the equal-spring coupling is a net dishing SOURCE, which is C-0047's own bar and C-0061's failure mode at a different placement: the free tile dishes 0.0638 at the 5 nm rest state and 0.1648 at the 2 nm held state, against 0.1104 and 0.2000 coupled — 1.73x and 1.21x WORSE than no coupling at all. The 34 roots are placed where a 10 nm layer's edge collar puts the load, and a 5 nm layer's is a different field: its free-tile dishing is 4.8x smaller at the rest state, so there is far less for a coupling to correct and the coupling's own sag dominates.

Where equal springs do clear, the distribution is worth little and C-0058's rim rule still runs the wrong way: the minimax over the design device's range reaches 0.0291 against 0.0789 (63.0 %) at a peak ratio of 1.83, while the rim rule gives 0.1599 at x2 and 0.2566 at its own x5 — the sign reversal C-0063 found at one state, reproduced over a range.

The exclusion of C-0022's 2 nm state from a 10 nm device's range is PHYSICAL and it changes no verdict here, because the device that does occupy that state is evaluated on its own: reaching a 2 nm gap from a 10 nm layer demands 8.0 nm of stroke against C-0050's 7.4235 nm, the largest dead-load stroke it finds anywhere at a 10 nm layer under S3's own 100 pN (6.0135 nm at S3's own grafting density), and C-0017's theorem says a coupling can only reduce it. The honest caveat: the same test does not clear the 5 nm device's own 3 nm either (1.5299 nm), so C-0022's 2 nm state is held by its solved 0.368 V bias rather than by a 100 pN dead load — a fact about C-0022's state set, recorded rather than smoothed.

C-0064's sign dichotomy transfers in DIRECTION and not in exactness: of the 31 non-empty subsets of C-0022's five headline states, the 14 that put the 2 nm state with a 10 nm state run 0.0985-0.1128 and 2 of them are inside 0.10, while the other 17 run 0.0191-0.0672 and 17 of 17 are — against 0 of 14 and 17 of 17 on C-0058's 3 x 15 grid. The five-state portfolio duty reaches 0.1124 here against C-0064's 0.1254 on that grid, so the placement does not repeal the incompatibility either; on this station set the ANTAGONIST IS THE 5 nm LAYER rather than the 2 nm gap alone — the two states of the 5 nm device are themselves anti-parallel, cosine -0.9427, where the 10 nm devices' own pairs run +0.9969 to +0.9998.

The placement was re-swept under the RANGE objective itself, exhaustively over the centro-symmetric family at both phases the congruence admits and under two objectives: phase 8, the worst over the 2 mM / 10 nm / 0.192 V device's traversed range, 163296 enumerated, best 0.0910 (flat: true) against C-0063's 0.0789, 0 better; phase 8, the worst over the 2 mM / 5 nm / 0.368 V device's traversed range, 163296 enumerated, best 0.0895 (flat: true) against C-0063's 0.2000, 30465 better; phase 24, the worst over the 2 mM / 10 nm / 0.192 V device's traversed range, 198288 enumerated, best 0.0789 (flat: true) against C-0063's 0.0789, 0 better; phase 24, the worst over the 2 mM / 5 nm / 0.368 V device's traversed range, 198288 enumerated, best 0.1169 (flat: false) against C-0063's 0.2000, 27355 better.
